example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ব্যবসায় অনেক কালোটাকা জড়িয়ে আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His business is involved in a lot of black money.
Black money is increasingly influencing the country's economy.
note: This term is widely used in Bengali-speaking regions to denote undeclared or illicit wealth, often linked to tax evasion and parallel economies.
